title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention, creating a more parallelizable sequence model and strong translation results.
summary_en: The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention, creating a more parallelizable sequence model and strong translation results.
summary_zh: Transformer 用注意力取代循环结构，让序列模型更易并行训练，并在机器翻译上取得强劲结果。

nodes.label: Sequential bottleneck
nodes.detail: Recurrent sequence models process positions sequentially, which limits parallelization during training.
nodes.detail_en: Recurrent sequence models process positions sequentially, which limits parallelization during training.
nodes.detail_zh: 循环序列模型按位置依次处理，限制训练时的并行化。
nodes.quote: The fundamental constraint of sequential computation, however, remains.

nodes.label: Attention before Transformer
nodes.detail: Attention can model dependencies over distance, but earlier systems usually combine it with recurrence.
nodes.detail_en: Attention can model dependencies over distance, but earlier systems usually combine it with recurrence.
nodes.detail_zh: 注意力可以跨距离建模依赖，但早期系统通常仍与循环网络结合。

nodes.label: Transformer thesis
nodes.detail: The Transformer removes recurrence and convolution and relies entirely on attention to draw global dependencies.
nodes.detail_en: The Transformer removes recurrence and convolution and relies entirely on attention to draw global dependencies.
nodes.detail_zh: Transformer 去掉循环和卷积，完全依靠注意力建立全局依赖。
nodes.quote: based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely

nodes.label: Encoder stack
nodes.detail: The encoder is a stack of N = 6 layers. Each layer combines multi-head self-attention, a feed-forward network, residual connections, and layer normalization.
nodes.detail_en: The encoder is a stack of N = 6 layers. Each layer combines multi-head self-attention, a feed-forward network, residual connections, and layer normalization.
nodes.detail_zh: 编码器由 N = 6 层组成，每层包含多头自注意力、前馈网络、残差连接和层归一化。

nodes.label: Decoder stack
nodes.detail: The decoder is also a stack of N = 6 layers and adds encoder-decoder attention plus masking of future tokens.
nodes.detail_en: The decoder is also a stack of N = 6 layers and adds encoder-decoder attention plus masking of future tokens.
nodes.detail_zh: 解码器同样由 N = 6 层组成，并加入编码器-解码器注意力和未来词元屏蔽。

nodes.label: Scaled dot-product
nodes.detail: Queries and keys are compared by dot product, divided by the square root of dk, then passed through softmax to weight the values.
nodes.detail_en: Queries and keys are compared by dot product, divided by the square root of dk, then passed through softmax to weight the values.
nodes.detail_zh: 查询和键先做点积，再除以 dk 的平方根并经过 softmax，用于加权求和值。
nodes.quote: The output is computed as a weighted sum of the values.

nodes.label: Multi-head attention
nodes.detail: The model uses h = 8 parallel heads, each with dk = dv = 64. The heads attend to different representation subspaces and positions.
nodes.detail_en: The model uses h = 8 parallel heads, each with dk = dv = 64. The heads attend to different representation subspaces and positions.
nodes.detail_zh: 模型使用 h = 8 个并行头，每个头的 dk = dv = 64，可关注不同表示子空间和位置。

nodes.label: Masked generation
nodes.detail: Decoder self-attention masks illegal future connections so each prediction only uses known output positions.
nodes.detail_en: Decoder self-attention masks illegal future connections so each prediction only uses known output positions.
nodes.detail_zh: 解码器自注意力屏蔽未来连接，使每次预测只能使用已知输出位置。

nodes.label: Position-wise feed-forward
nodes.detail: Each layer applies two linear transformations with ReLU independently at every position. The inner dimension is dff = 2048 and the model dimension is dmodel = 512.
nodes.detail_en: Each layer applies two linear transformations with ReLU independently at every position. The inner dimension is dff = 2048 and the model dimension is dmodel = 512.
nodes.detail_zh: 每层在每个位置独立执行两次线性变换和 ReLU；内部维度为 dff = 2048，模型维度为 dmodel = 512。

nodes.label: Positional encoding
nodes.detail: Sinusoidal encodings are added because the attention-only model has no recurrence or convolution to represent token order.
nodes.detail_en: Sinusoidal encodings are added because the attention-only model has no recurrence or convolution to represent token order.
nodes.detail_zh: 由于没有循环或卷积，模型加入正弦位置编码来表示词元顺序。
nodes.quote: The wavelengths form a geometric progression from 2π to 10000 · 2π.

nodes.label: Parallel computation
nodes.detail: Self-attention has O(n^2 · d) per-layer operations, O(1) sequential operations, and O(1) maximum path length, while recurrent layers require O(n) sequential operations.
nodes.detail_en: Self-attention has O(n^2 · d) per-layer operations, O(1) sequential operations, and O(1) maximum path length, while recurrent layers require O(n) sequential operations.
nodes.detail_zh: 自注意力每层运算量为 O(n^2 · d)，顺序运算为 O(1)，最大路径长度为 O(1)；循环层需要 O(n) 次顺序运算。

nodes.label: WMT14 English-German
nodes.detail: The best Transformer reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German, improving over existing best results by over 2 BLEU.
nodes.detail_en: The best Transformer reaches 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German, improving over existing best results by over 2 BLEU.
nodes.detail_zh: 最佳 Transformer 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译上达到 28.4 BLEU，比已有最佳结果高出 2 BLEU 以上。

nodes.label: WMT14 English-French
nodes.detail: On English-to-French, the model reaches 41.8 BLEU after training for 3.5 days on 8 GPUs.
nodes.detail_en: On English-to-French, the model reaches 41.8 BLEU after training for 3.5 days on 8 GPUs.
nodes.detail_zh: 在英法翻译上，模型在 8 个 GPU 上训练 3.5 天后达到 41.8 BLEU。

nodes.label: Parsing generalization
nodes.detail: A 4-layer Transformer reaches 91.3 F1 on WSJ-only parsing and 92.7 F1 in the semi-supervised setting, showing transfer beyond translation.
nodes.detail_en: A 4-layer Transformer reaches 91.3 F1 on WSJ-only parsing and 92.7 F1 in the semi-supervised setting, showing transfer beyond translation.
nodes.detail_zh: 4 层 Transformer 在 WSJ-only 句法分析上达到 91.3 F1，半监督设置达到 92.7 F1，说明它可以泛化到翻译之外。

nodes.label: Attention visualization
nodes.detail: The paper visualizes a long-distance dependency in layer 5 of 6, where heads connect the verb “making” to the phrase “more difficult”.
nodes.detail_en: The paper visualizes a long-distance dependency in layer 5 of 6, where heads connect the verb “making” to the phrase “more difficult”.
nodes.detail_zh: 论文展示第 5/6 层中的长距离依赖，注意力头把动词“making”连接到“more difficult”。

nodes.label: Limits and next steps
nodes.detail: The authors propose local attention for very long sequences and future applications to images, audio, and video.
nodes.detail_en: The authors propose local attention for very long sequences and future applications to images, audio, and video.
nodes.detail_zh: 作者提出研究超长序列的局部注意力，并计划扩展到图像、音频和视频。

nodes.label: Attention replaces recurrence
nodes.detail: The paper presents attention-only sequence transduction as a strong and more parallelizable alternative to recurrent and convolutional architectures.
nodes.detail_en: The paper presents attention-only sequence transduction as a strong and more parallelizable alternative to recurrent and convolutional architectures.
nodes.detail_zh: 论文展示了只使用注意力的序列转换模型，成为循环和卷积架构的高并行替代方案。
nodes.quote: attention, replacing recurrent layers with multi-headed self-attention
